versions.content: {DRAFT} If the CanIf module notifies PN availability for a configured CAN Controller to the CanSM module with the callback function CanSM_ConfirmCtrlPnAvailability (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_91004]), then the CanSM module shall call the API CanNm_ConfirmPnAvailability (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_91002]) with the related CAN network as channel to confirm the PN availability to the CanNm module.
